{{Top|leg}}
The '''X-C 2 ion drive array''' was a high-output, experimental [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] designed by [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]]. The ion array was first used in the [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]] [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']].
